t4: Use the impact report to safely update or deprecate the field without breaking dependent workflows.

title: Partner Data to Prospecting Paid Media
t1: Ingest partner-provided prospect data into Experience Platform, mapping attributes to a partner prospect schema.

title: Enrich profiles with partner financial attributes
t1: Ingest partner-provided financial segment data into Experience Platform using a partner data source connector.

t4: Build audiences segmented by the enriched financial attributes and activate them to your marketing destinations.

title: Personalize content for unknown visitors
source: Partner Data / Personalize for unknown visitors
t1: Integrate a partner data provider to supply identity signals for anonymous website visitors with no known profile.

t4: Activate the anonymous visitor audience to your web personalization destination to deliver tailored content in real time.

title: Partner data to prospecting audience
t1: Ingest partner-provided enrichment data into Experience Platform by onboarding partner attributes to your existing customer profiles.

t3: Use partner lookalike modeling to expand the seed audience into a net-new prospecting audience of unknown users who resemble your best customers.
t4: Activate the lookalike prospecting audience to offsite advertising destinations to drive new customer acquisition.

title: Playbook to cart re-engagement assets
source: Use Case Playbooks / Browse and instantiate
t1: Browse the Use Case Playbook gallery and select the abandoned cart re-engagement playbook that matches your goal.

title: Churn Prevention Playbook to Sandbox Assets
source: Use Case Playbooks / Browse and instantiate
t1: Browse the Use Case Playbooks gallery and select a churn prevention playbook that matches your business goal.

t4: Publish the playbook assets to your sandbox so they are ready to configure and activate.

title: B2B account nurture ABM campaign
source: Use Case Playbooks / Browse and instantiate
t1: Browse the Use Case Playbook gallery and select a B2B account nurture playbook as your starting point.
t2: Create an instance of the playbook to generate its pre-built assets, including schemas, segments, and journeys.

t4: Publish the finalized playbook assets to your sandbox and activate the account audience to your ABM destination.

title: Review and import playbook artifacts
t1: Browse the playbook gallery and create an instance of a playbook to generate its artifacts.
t2: Review the generated artifacts, such as schemas, datasets, and journeys, inside the playbook instance.
t3: Publish the playbook package from the source sandbox to make the artifacts available for export.
t4: Import the published package into your development sandbox to begin building with those assets.

title: Set up playbook inspiration sandbox
t1: Create a dedicated sandbox in Experience Platform to serve as the playbook inspiration environment.

title: Build KPI Dashboard for Audience Metrics
t1: Create a custom dashboard in Experience Platform and give it a name and description to identify its purpose.
t2: Add widgets to the dashboard that pull real-time data for profile counts and audience sizes from the profile store.
t3: Add additional widgets displaying activation metrics such as audiences activated per destination and segment membership trends.
t4: Save and publish the dashboard so stakeholders can monitor KPI trends across profiles, audiences, and activations.

title: Build executive segment and delivery dashboard
t1: Create a custom dashboard in the Dashboards UI and give it a name that reflects its executive audience.
t2: Add widgets that display segment health metrics such as audience size, growth trends, and profile coverage.
t3: Add destination delivery widgets showing activation success rates, dataflow run statuses, and records delivered per destination.
t4: Save and share the completed dashboard so executives can monitor segment health and delivery performance in one view.

title: Build ingestion health monitoring dashboard
t1: Create a custom dashboard in Experience Platform and give it a meaningful name for tracking ingestion health.
t2: Add widgets that query batch ingestion metrics, such as records ingested, failed batches, and job status counts.
t3: Configure each widget to filter data by day so that success and failure rates reflect the correct daily time window.
t4: Save and publish the dashboard so stakeholders can monitor daily batch job success rates in real time.

title: Confirm and delete expired test dataset
t1: Review the test dataset in the Data Lake to confirm it is expired and no longer referenced by any active schemas or segments.
t2: Check that no active destinations or journeys depend on the dataset before proceeding with deletion.
t3: Submit a dataset expiration request in the Data Hygiene workspace, specifying the target dataset and deletion date.
t4: Verify the dataset has been fully removed from the Data Lake by confirming it no longer appears in the dataset inventory.

title: Find and delete failed ingestion batch
t1: Monitor batch ingestion status in the platform to identify a failed or incorrect batch containing bad records.
t2: Note the batch ID of the failed ingestion so you can target it precisely for deletion.
t3: Submit a batch delete request using that batch ID to remove the incorrect records from the dataset.
t4: Verify the deletion is complete by confirming the records no longer appear in the dataset or unified profiles.

title: Set expiration on campaign dataset
t1: Navigate to the Data Lifecycle workspace and select the temporary campaign dataset you want to expire.
t2: Create a dataset expiration request by specifying the exact date on which the dataset should be deleted.
t3: Submit the expiration request so that Platform schedules the automatic deletion of the dataset on that date.
t4: Verify the scheduled expiration appears on the dataset record, confirming it will be automatically removed on the configured date.

title: Expire inactive pseudonymous profiles automatically
t1: Review your dataset and confirm which profiles lack authenticated identities and qualify as pseudonymous.
t2: Navigate to Data Hygiene settings and configure a pseudonymous profile expiration policy set to 30 days of inactivity.
t3: Platform evaluates all pseudonymous profiles against the 30-day inactivity threshold and flags expired records for deletion.
t4: Expired pseudonymous profiles are automatically removed from the profile store, freeing storage and keeping data clean.

title: Query and delete stale records
t1: Connect to Query Service and run SQL queries against your datasets to surface records that have not been updated beyond your staleness threshold.
t2: Review the query results to confirm the identified records are genuinely stale and eligible for deletion, noting their primary identities.
t3: Submit a record delete hygiene job in Experience Platform using the confirmed identities of those stale records.
t4: Monitor the hygiene job status until completion and re-run validation queries to confirm the stale records have been removed from the dataset.

title: Size audience and resolve journey conflicts
source: Marketing Workflows / Plan and size campaign
t1: Build a candidate audience in Segment Builder and review the estimated profile count to confirm the campaign is sized correctly.
t2: Inspect each profile's active journey memberships to identify any customers already enrolled in a conflicting journey.
t3: Exclude or suppress the conflicting profiles from the campaign audience to prevent overlapping communications.
t4: Finalize the cleaned audience and launch the campaign journey, confident there are no messaging conflicts.

title: Configure and publish re-engagement journey
t1: Build an audience of lapsed customers who have not engaged within a defined time window.
t2: Design the re-engagement journey in Journey Optimizer, adding the audience as the entry trigger.
t3: Configure the journey steps with personalized messages, wait nodes, and channel actions such as email or push.
t4: Review and publish the journey so that qualifying customers begin receiving re-engagement communications.

title: Analyze post-campaign conversion rates CJA

t3: Create a CJA data view that defines conversion metrics and campaign attribution dimensions for reporting.
t4: Build a Workspace project with funnel and conversion rate visualizations to review post-campaign performance.

title: AI-driven win-back offer delivery
t1: Configure a Customer AI propensity model to score customers on their likelihood to churn.

t3: Build an audience in Segment Builder by filtering profiles with high churn propensity scores.
t4: Activate the audience into a Journey Optimizer campaign to deliver a personalized win-back offer.

title: Cart abandonment push notification journey
t1: Capture real-time cart abandonment events from your website or app using the Web SDK or Mobile SDK.
t2: Define a segment of customers who added items to their cart but did not complete a purchase within a set time window.
t3: Build a Journey Optimizer journey triggered by the cart abandonment event for that audience.
t4: Send a personalized push notification reminding each customer of their abandoned cart items to drive conversion.

title: Notify customers of loyalty tier upgrade
t1: Create an audience of customers who have newly qualified for a higher loyalty tier based on their recent purchase activity.
t2: Build a journey in Journey Optimizer triggered by entry into that loyalty tier upgrade audience.
t3: Author the tier upgrade notification message with personalized content reflecting the customer's new tier benefits.
t4: Publish the journey so newly qualified customers automatically receive the tier upgrade notification across their preferred channel.

title: Review channel attribution after product launch
t1: Open Customer Journey Analytics and select the product launch date range to scope the analysis.
t2: Load the cross-channel attribution panel to see how each channel contributed to conversions during the launch.
t3: Compare attribution models to identify which channels drove the most assisted and last-touch conversions.
t4: Export the KPI summary and share the report with stakeholders to inform future campaign investment decisions.

title: Query audience size and check journey conflicts
t1: Open Adobe Marketing Agent and ask it to retrieve the current size of your target audience segment.

t3: Ask Adobe Marketing Agent to scan all live journeys for any that are already targeting the same audience segment.
t4: Review the identified conflicts and adjust journey entry conditions or audience assignments to eliminate overlap before launch.

title: Connect and share with media partner
t1: Navigate to Segment Match in Experience Platform and initiate a new connection request to your media partner organization.

t4: Approve and activate the share so the partner receives the matched audience in their sandbox for co-marketing campaigns.

title: Accept partner audience for prospecting
t1: Review and accept the incoming segment share request from your data partner in Segment Match.

t4: Activate the combined prospecting audience to your advertising destination to launch the prospecting campaign.

title: Preview audience overlap before partner share
t1: Build an audience segment of the customers you want to evaluate for potential partner sharing.

t3: Review the estimated overlap count and percentage to assess mutual value before committing to the share.
t4: Decide whether to proceed with the full audience share to your partner based on the overlap insights.

t4: Activate the resulting audiences to your advertising and marketing destinations.

title: Re-engage checkout abandoners intelligently

t4: Launch a personalized re-engagement journey across email, push, and paid channels to bring them back.

title: AI-Driven Churn Prevention Campaign

t4: Activate the churn-risk audience to email and advertising destinations to deliver targeted retention offers in real time.

title: Collect, unify, and activate customer data

t4: Activate the audiences to advertising, email, and other destinations to deliver consistent cross-channel experiences.

title: Real-time profile to relevant offer
t1: Ingest customer behavioral and transactional data into Experience Platform to build a rich real-time customer profile.

title: Analyze omnichannel conversion funnels with CJA

t3: Execute the query to compare field values across both schemas and surface any mapping discrepancies in the results.
t4: Review the query output to confirm all fields are correctly mapped and the migrated data matches the expected schema structure.

title: Query Service to Tableau attribution report
t1: Navigate to Query Service in Experience Platform and export your PostgreSQL credentials including host, port, and authentication details.
t2: Open Tableau Desktop and create a new connection using the exported Query Service credentials to establish a live connection to the platform.
t3: Write and run a SQL query in Tableau to pull attribution and campaign performance data from Experience Platform datasets.
t4: Build an attribution performance report in Tableau by visualizing the queried data with charts, filters, and calculated metrics.

title: Diagnose batch ingestion failure in monitoring
t1: Open the Monitoring dashboard in Experience Platform and navigate to the Data Ingestion section.
t2: Select the failed batch from the list of recent ingestion runs to open its detail view.
t3: Review the batch status and identify which records failed during ingestion.
t4: Expand the failed record entries to read the specific error messages explaining why ingestion failed.

title: Monitor and verify audience export counts
t1: Activate an audience to a destination so that an export job is triggered and data begins flowing.
t2: Navigate to the Destinations monitoring dashboard to locate the active dataflow for that destination.
t3: Open the dataflow detail view to inspect the export run and confirm the number of identities exported.
t4: Compare the exported profile count against expected audience size to verify the activation completed successfully.

title: Subscribe and acknowledge destination alert
t1: Navigate to a destination dataflow in the Platform UI and open the alerts subscription panel.
t2: Subscribe to the destination dataflow failure alert to enable notifications for that dataflow.
t3: Wait for the dataflow to fail, triggering the alert notification in the Platform alerts inbox.
t4: Open the triggered alert notification and acknowledge it to mark the incident as reviewed.

title: Find and fix recurring ingestion schema error
t1: Navigate to the Monitoring dashboard and open the dataflow run history for the relevant source connector.
t2: Identify the recurring failed runs and inspect the error details to confirm a schema mismatch is causing ingestion failures.
t3: Update the source schema or field mappings in the dataflow configuration to resolve the mismatch.
t4: Trigger a new dataflow run and confirm in the monitoring dashboard that data ingests successfully without schema errors.

title: Bulk CRM customer privacy erasure job
t1: Export the list of customers requiring erasure from your CRM, collecting their identity values such as email and customer ID.
t2: Submit a bulk privacy delete job to Privacy Service via API, providing each customer's identity namespace and value pairs.
t3: Privacy Service fans out the delete request to all configured Experience Platform services, including Profile, Identity, and data lake.
t4: Monitor the job status in Privacy Service until all delete requests complete, confirming the customers' data has been fully erased.

title: Submit and fulfill customer DSAR export
t1: Submit a DSAR access request via the Privacy Service API or UI, specifying the customer's identity details and the datasets to search.
t2: Privacy Service fans out the request to all configured Experience Cloud products and retrieves the customer's matching data records.
t3: Privacy Service compiles the retrieved records into a complete data export package once all products have responded.
t4: Download the finished export package from Privacy Service and deliver it to the customer to fulfill the DSAR.

title: Webhook for privacy job event triggers
t1: Register a webhook endpoint in your system to receive incoming HTTP event notifications from Adobe Privacy Service.
t2: Subscribe the webhook to Privacy Service job status events using the Event Notifications configuration in Experience Platform.
t3: Submit a privacy job request through Privacy Service to generate a real status event payload.
t4: Receive the event notification at your webhook endpoint and trigger your automated downstream workflow based on the job status.

title: Loyalty re-engagement playbook to journey
source: Use Case Playbooks / Browse and instantiate
t1: Browse the Use Case Playbook gallery and select a loyalty re-engagement playbook that matches your campaign goal.
t2: Create an instance of the playbook to generate its supporting assets, including schemas, datasets, and segments.
t3: Review and publish the generated templates and audience assets to your development sandbox.
t4: Use the generated journey template to launch a personalized loyalty re-engagement journey for at-risk customers.

title: Publish Playbook Assets to Dev Sandbox
t1: Browse the use case playbook gallery and create an instance of a playbook that matches your campaign scenario.
t2: Review the playbook-generated assets, including schemas, datasets, and audiences, in the inspirational sandbox.
t3: Publish the playbook package so its assets become available for import into another sandbox.
t4: Import the published package into your development sandbox to begin customizing schemas and audiences for your use case.

title: Configure sandbox for playbooks access
t1: Create a new sandbox in Experience Platform to serve as the dedicated environment for Use Case Playbooks.
t2: Add the sandbox to the appropriate product profile in Admin Console so users can access it.
t3: Assign the required Use Case Playbooks permissions to the role in the Permissions UI for that sandbox.
t4: Open the Use Case Playbooks catalog in the configured sandbox to browse and launch available playbooks.

title: Enrich profiles with partner scores
t1: Ingest first-party customer profiles into Experience Platform and ensure they are unified in the Real-Time Customer Profile.
t2: Import partner-provided propensity score attributes and match them to your first-party profiles using shared identity keys.
t3: Build an audience in Segment Builder by filtering profiles based on the partner propensity score thresholds.
t4: Activate the enriched audience to your advertising or email destination to deliver targeted campaigns.

title: Personalize landing page for anonymous visitors
source: Partner Data / Personalize for unknown visitors
t1: Integrate a partner data provider to resolve anonymous visitor identifiers and attach partner-supplied attributes to the unknown visitor's profile.
t2: Use the partner-resolved attributes to build an audience segment representing anonymous visitors with specific interests or intent signals.
t3: Configure a personalization destination to deliver tailored landing page content based on the anonymous visitor's segment membership.
t4: Serve the personalized landing page experience to the anonymous visitor in real time using the activated partner-enriched audience.

title: Partner data to DSP prospecting audience
t1: Ingest partner-provided prospect data into Experience Platform using partner data connectors to access new potential customers.
t2: Enrich your existing high-value customer profiles with partner attributes to build a lookalike seed audience in Segment Builder.
t3: Expand the seed audience into a partner-enriched lookalike audience targeting net-new customers who resemble your best customers.
t4: Activate the lookalike audience to your DSP destination to run offsite prospecting campaigns and acquire new customers.

title: Partner attributes to financial product targeting
t1: Ingest partner-supplied income-band attributes into Experience Platform as a partner data source.
t2: Map and append those income-band attributes to known customer profiles using profile enrichment.
t3: Build an audience of high-income-band profiles eligible for targeted financial products using Segment Builder.
t4: Activate the enriched audience to advertising and email destinations to deliver personalized financial product offers.

title: Profile completeness dashboard with email tracking
t1: Query the profile dataset using Query Service to calculate the percentage of profiles that contain a valid email address.
t2: Save the query results as a derived dataset that exposes the email completeness metric for visualization.
t3: Create a custom dashboard in the Dashboards UI and add a new widget pointed at the derived dataset.
t4: Configure the widget to display the email completeness percentage so stakeholders can monitor profile quality over time.

title: Destination health dashboard for activation success
t1: Create a custom dashboard in Experience Platform and add widgets tracking activation job statuses across all configured destinations.
t2: Configure each widget to query activation metrics such as records sent, failed, and skipped per destination channel.
t3: Arrange and save the dashboard layout to display success rates side by side for each channel.
t4: Share the published dashboard with stakeholders to monitor destination health and activation success rates in real time.

title: Monitor profile volume against entitlements
t1: Navigate to the License Usage dashboard in Experience Platform to view your current entitlement limits and consumption metrics.
t2: Identify the relevant profile volume widgets and configure them to display the metrics most critical to your entitlement thresholds.
t3: Create a custom dashboard and add widgets that track profile count, addressable audiences, and richness against licensed limits.
t4: Set alert thresholds on the dashboard so your team is notified when profile volume approaches or exceeds entitlement limits.

title: Customer AI Scores to Custom Dashboard
t1: Configure and run a Customer AI model to generate propensity scores for your customer profiles.
t2: Verify that the propensity score attributes have been written to the unified Real-Time Customer Profile dataset.
t3: Create a custom dashboard in Platform and add widgets that query the propensity score dataset.
t4: Visualise the propensity score distributions across your customer base directly within the custom Platform dashboard.

title: Delete bad batch and re-ingest corrected data
t1: Identify the mis-mapped ingestion batch in the dataset activity view and note its batch ID.
t2: Submit a batch delete request using that batch ID to remove the incorrect records from the dataset and profile store.
t3: Confirm the batch deletion is complete and verify the mis-mapped records no longer appear in the dataset.
t4: Re-ingest the corrected source file into the same dataset so accurate records populate the customer profiles.

title: Schedule expiry for campaign event datasets
t1: Identify the time-boxed campaign event datasets whose data should be automatically removed after a defined retention period.
t2: Navigate to Data Hygiene in the Platform UI and create a dataset expiration request for the first campaign dataset, setting the expiry date.
t3: Repeat the dataset expiration configuration for each remaining campaign event dataset, assigning the appropriate expiry date to each.
t4: Review and confirm all scheduled dataset expirations so Platform automatically deletes each campaign dataset on its designated expiry date.

title: Audit and expire obsolete datasets
t1: Navigate to the Datasets inventory in Experience Platform and review each dataset's storage size and last ingestion date.
t2: Flag datasets that are large, inactive, or no longer needed by comparing them against current business use cases and data retention requirements.
t3: Set a dataset expiration date on each identified obsolete dataset to schedule it for automatic deletion.
t4: Confirm the expiration schedule and monitor the Data Hygiene dashboard to verify that targeted datasets are removed and storage is reclaimed.

title: Evaluate partner overlap before sharing
t1: Build an audience of your key customer segment in Experience Platform using Segment Builder.
t2: Send a connection request to your data partner through Segment Match to initiate the overlap estimation process.
t3: Review the pre-share overlap estimates to see how many identities your audience shares with the partner's audience.
t4: Use the overlap insights to decide whether the partner audience share is worth pursuing before activating any data.

title: Segment Match CPG Partnership Handshake
t1: Share your Segment Match connection ID with the CPG brand partner so they can initiate the partnership request.
t2: Receive and accept the incoming connection request from the CPG brand in the Segment Match UI to establish the partnership.
t3: Overlap your audiences with the partner's audiences using privacy-safe overlap estimates to validate joint targeting value.
t4: Share the agreed audience segments with the CPG brand partner to activate joint campaign targeting across both organizations.

title: Review and accept shared audience governance
t1: Open the incoming Segment Match feed and review the partner's data usage labels and governance terms attached to the shared audience.
t2: Evaluate whether the partner's governance terms align with your organization's data usage policies and compliance requirements.
t3: Confirm compliance by accepting the governance terms within the Segment Match configuration, unlocking access to the shared audience.
t4: Activate the accepted shared audience to your desired destination for use in downstream campaigns.

title: Automated win-back journey from churn score
t1: Configure Customer AI to run a churn propensity model and generate a score for every customer profile.
t2: Build an audience in Segment Builder that captures all profiles whose churn score exceeds your defined threshold.
t3: Design a Journey Optimizer journey that triggers automatically when a customer enters that high-churn audience.
t4: Activate the journey to deliver a personalized win-back offer across email and push channels to those at-risk customers.

title: Timed cart abandonment reminder series
t1: Configure a streaming event trigger in Journey Optimizer that fires when a customer adds items to their cart but does not complete checkout within a set time window.
t2: Build the journey canvas with a timed wait node followed by a first reminder step that sends a personalized cart abandonment email listing the abandoned items.
t3: Add a second wait node and a conditional split to check whether the customer has since purchased, then send a push notification reminder with an incentive to those who have not.
t4: Activate and publish the journey so that every qualifying cart abandoner automatically receives the full timed email and push reminder series until they convert or exit.

title: Size and budget a holiday campaign
source: Marketing Workflows / Plan and size campaign
t1: Build a candidate audience in Segment Builder targeting holiday shoppers and preview the estimated profile count.
t2: Review the audience size breakdown by channel to confirm sufficient reach for the campaign goals.
t3: Align the confirmed audience size with the finance team to validate and approve the budget allocation.
t4: Lock the approved audience and budget, then schedule the holiday campaign for launch.

title: Attribution metrics to PowerPoint deck
t1: Connect Adobe Marketing Agent to Customer Journey Analytics to access campaign attribution data and channel performance metrics.
t2: Query the attribution metrics using Adobe Marketing Agent, pulling multi-touch attribution scores and conversion data across all channels.
t3: Use Adobe Marketing Agent to organize and summarize the retrieved attribution metrics into structured, presentation-ready content.
t4: Export the summarized attribution insights directly into a PowerPoint deck for stakeholder reporting and campaign review.

title: Onboard new loyalty programme members
t1: Configure a streaming sign-up event in Journey Optimizer to serve as the entry trigger for new loyalty programme members.
t2: Build the onboarding journey canvas, adding personalised email, SMS, and wait steps that guide the new member through programme benefits.
t3: Define the journey entry conditions and eligibility rules so only new loyalty sign-ups enter the flow exactly once.
t4: Publish the journey so it activates automatically each time a new member sign-up event is received in real time.

title: Customer AI scores drive homepage recommendations
t1: Configure a Customer AI model by selecting your dataset and defining the propensity goal, such as likelihood to purchase.
t2: Run the Customer AI model to generate individual propensity scores written back to each customer's real-time profile.
t3: Build audience segments by filtering profiles on the generated propensity score thresholds, separating high from low intent customers.
t4: Activate those audience segments to your personalisation destination to serve tailored product recommendations on the homepage for each segment.

title: Score profiles and activate upgrade audience
t1: Configure a Customer AI instance by selecting the travel purchase dataset and setting upgrade likelihood as the prediction goal.
t2: Run the Customer AI model to generate propensity scores for every customer profile in the dataset.
t3: Build an audience in Segment Builder by filtering profiles whose upgrade propensity score falls in the top decile.
t4: Activate the top-decile upgrade audience to your email and advertising destinations to deliver targeted upgrade offers.

title: Compare attribution models with Attribution AI
t1: Configure an Attribution AI model instance by selecting your conversion events and touchpoint channels as inputs.
t2: Run the Attribution AI model to generate touchpoint scores across your customer journeys.
t3: View the first-touch attribution results in the Attribution AI insights dashboard to see which channels get credit.
t4: Switch the attribution model view to data-driven scores and compare how credit is redistributed across touchpoints versus first-touch.

title: Attribution insights drive budget reallocation
t1: Connect your conversion and touchpoint datasets to Attribution AI and configure the model with your desired attribution approach.
t2: Run the Attribution AI model to generate channel-level influence scores across display and paid search touchpoints.
t3: Analyze the Attribution AI insights dashboard to compare the true conversion influence of display ads versus paid search.
t4: Use the paid search attribution advantage revealed by the scores to justify reallocating budget away from display to paid search campaigns.

title: Score profiles for subscription cancellation risk
t1: Configure a Customer AI instance by selecting subscription cancellation events as the prediction goal and defining the scoring population.
t2: Connect the relevant datasets containing subscription and behavioral data so Customer AI can train its propensity model.
t3: Run the Customer AI instance to generate churn propensity scores for all eligible customer profiles.
t4: Use the generated scores to build audiences segmented by cancellation risk level and activate them to retention campaigns.
